listing.name: Strider 2 Recompiled
listing.summary: Prepare your own USA Strider 2 disc with the upstream setup kit and use the completed player.

steps.title: Complete the title’s supported preparation upstream
steps.instruction: Complete the supported upstream setup from your own USA SLUS-01163 CUE and every associated BIN before attachment. The release-root Strider_Recompiled.exe is a setup host; it generates and builds the completed game in build-release. Keep the whole creating project and output together. Portcove does not perform generation or redistribute private generated game code.

steps.title: Use the matching original and setup procedure
steps.instruction: This title uses generated OpenBIOS by default. A separately owned retail BIOS is optional under its upstream setup; do not copy Street Fighter EX2 Plus’s mandatory retail-BIOS requirement into this title. Preserve your actual selected BIOS and configuration if you use one.

steps.title: Add the completed supported game program
steps.instruction: Select the completed build-release/Strider_Recompiled.exe with its executable directory as working directory and --launcher as the literal argument. Do not attach the release-root setup host or an SDK emitter. The completed game-dispatch binary bypasses setup forwarding; its native main owns launcher/game execution.

steps.title: Prepare the official Linux or Mac kit
steps.instruction: Extract the complete Linux x86-64, Intel Mac or Apple Silicon Mac ZIP for your host. The observed Linux setup player needs glibc 2.38 and libstdc++ providing GLIBCXX_3.4.29, plus the host OpenGL and zlib libraries libOpenGL.so.0 and libz.so.1. The Mac setup player has a macOS 11 minimum. Select the Apple Command Line Tools or Xcode toolchain for its Clang and SDK. Install upstream’s required Python 3 and use its Generate & rebuild wizard and supported toolchain. Supply your own USA SLUS-01163 CUE and all referenced BIN files. The title uses generated OpenBIOS by default. A separately owned retail BIOS is optional under its upstream setup. Start the completed build-release/Strider_Recompiled in its own folder after upstream setup. Keep it with its matching config, assets and the complete creating project.

steps.title: Review launch details and manage updates
steps.instruction: Review the selected game executable, working folder and launch arguments, then agree to use them. Choose Play separately when you are ready. You manage setup, game replacement and recovery. Removing the registration leaves external files in place. Before changing versions, close the game and its companion programs and keep the working copy and every data location it uses. Review and select the changed executable before playing again. Portcove does not offer updates, backups, rollback, conversion, data migration or deletion for these external files.

warnings: Use only a copy and components you are permitted to use. Keep the complete working game, originals, saves, settings, mods, caches, backups and every custom data location before changing versions. Another executable may use those same locations. These instructions do not establish Portcove-managed installation, gameplay or save compatibility.
The Linux and Mac kits perform local generation and use upstream setup and replacement. Package inspection does not qualify a generated native game, multiplayer or a save migration.

references.title: Preserve the whole creating copy and effective data
references.instruction: Keep the complete creating project/build-release, own original CUE/BIN, generated game code and any selected BIOS. Preserve settings.toml, input.ini, configured memory cards, states, mods, controller mappings, caches, backups and every effective custom root. Retain the framework PolyForm and separate third-party notices; no cross-title or cross-fork save/runtime compatibility is assumed.
